name: Virtual Lab
description: Team of LLM scientist agents, led by a principal investigator agent, that hold meetings to tackle open research problems.
whatItDoes: Organises group and one-to-one meetings between role-playing scientist agents to plan and carry out research, with a human providing direction. It was demonstrated on designing nanobodies.
howItWorks: A Python package defines agents with roles and runs structured meetings with agendas, critiques and summaries through the OpenAI API. Workflows are driven from notebooks.
